description: We are To Mars and Back: five TUM students and one from HHN, studying computer science, data science and management. We bring skills in coding (TypeScript, React, Python), 3D maps, computer vision, data science and project management. Our project Mars Seek plans a safe route for the first human walk on Mars and guides the astronaut with a helmet that spots dangers on its own. We believe space tools should be simple to use in a spacesuit and work without help from Earth.
